notes.title: Update details for Version 0.0.4
notes.content:
We sincerely apologise for the prolonged silence since the release.

We are currently developing tutorial functionality, though it appears this will take a little more time.

Therefore, we will be implementing minor updates within the game!!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703078/f644af029a8acb9030fd88b3dbb39f6e3b92a88b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703078/c5da5f54d39fd15ae95af1916f8d08bd040c44cd.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703078/c558fbd0567a51a5cde9400b0bd2ad26dd2ed551.png"]※The screenshots shown are work-in-progress images. They may change after release.



This update primarily involves changing the font.

We believe this will make the previously rather plain screens look richer.

For the next update, we are considering adding one more song.

We haven't set a date for the next update yet, so please be patient.



Until next time!

notes.title: Updated to version 0.0.3!!
notes.content:
